reserveReview.rationale: Renewal 2026-11-19 re-verified the issuer-documented delta-neutral structure and Ceffu/Binance custody model from the current Aster documentation and again found no public dashboard, attestation, or reserve report publishing retained-USDT, spot-crypto, or futures-margin weights. The full docs index (llms.txt, retrieved 2026-11-19) still lists only overview, mechanism, custody, tutorial, FAQ, and landscape pages for USDF; the audit-reports page lists only smart-contract audits for USDF (PeckShield, HALBORN) and no reserve or holdings attestation. The re-read pages still describe USDT 1:1 mint into a Ceffu wallet, MirrorX 1:1 balance delegation to a Binance sub-account while assets remain in Ceffu custody with off-exchange settlement and T+1 withdrawals, spot BTC/ETH longs against matching short perpetual notional, and RWA yield sources only as future opportunities. The standing issuer documentation is re-observed on 2026-11-19, so the composition date follows the review convention of dating the re-verified standing structure claim; the slice keeps its conservative high risk tier, so the re-date cannot improve the score through favorable tiers. Because no supply-weighted split is published and the collateral is an off-exchange, strategy-managed basket, the single reserve remains dispositioned as an untracked exogenous hedged-crypto envelope rather than a splittable stablecoin basket.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Aster-documented delta-neutral backing structure and Aster's description of Ceffu MirrorX custody delegation; constituent shares are undisclosed
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The reserve class and counterparties are identified, but Aster does not publish current weights for retained USDT, spot BTC/ETH, or futures-margin exposure.

The strategy is an off-exchange, Ceffu-custodied hedged-crypto envelope and is therefore treated as an untracked exogenous asset.

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-4 (lead usdf-falcon)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: Aster documents Ceffu custody with MirrorX off-exchange settlement onto Binance, under which assets remain with the custodian while balances are mirrored to the exchange for the delta-neutral strategy. Account-level segregation, insolvency treatment, and the exact scope of assets deployed as futures margin are not established by the reviewed sources.
